input.guide:
# Demo workspace guide: a fictional community board app

Members create or join group boards, write posts on boards, and comment on or like other members' posts. All data is fictional and generated from deterministic random numbers.

## Terms

- **Member**: a user who signed up. Leaving sets `deleted_at`.
- **Board (group)**: created by a member (`owner_member_id`) and joined by others. Boards can be deleted.
- **Posts, comments, replies, likes**: writing activity on a board. A reply is a comment on a comment (`is_nested`).
- **Connection**: being a member of the same board as another member at the same time.

## Rules (already applied in the derived tables)

- Signup weeks start on Monday (`signup_week`, `YYYY-MM-DD`).
- Cohort metrics only use members who signed up on or after `cohort_start` (`d_member` already filters them).
- A membership interval is `[joined_at, ended_at)`: it ends at the earlier of leaving the board and the board's deletion (no end if neither).
- Deleted activity still counts as activity at the time it happened (`d_activity.source_deleted` marks it).
- The first-week funnel (`d_member_first_week`) only has members at least 7 days past signup, and each step is set only for members who reached the previous one (otherwise NULL).
- This demo has no undecidable states (join times are exact). The funnel's `unknown` column is still 0.

## Defaults

- First-week window: 7 days after signup.
- Retention: Wn = at least one activity in days [7n, 7n+7) after signup; the denominator only has members whose window has fully passed (observable). Members who left stay in the denominator.
- Activity: any post, comment, reply or like (all of `d_activity`). For posts only, use `kind = 'post'`.
- "Last N weeks" means the last N signup weeks whose observation window has ended.

## Columns

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `d_member.signup_at` | Signup time |
| `d_member.signup_week` | Signup week (Monday, YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `d_activity.kind` | post / reply / nested_reply / reaction |
| `d_activity.at` | Activity time |
| `d_activity.source_deleted` | 1 if the source row was deleted |
| `d_membership.joined_at` | Time the member joined the board (creation time for the creator) |
| `d_membership.ended_at` | End of membership (earlier of leaving and board deletion; NULL if neither) |
| `d_membership.is_owner` | 1 if the member created the board |
| `d_member_first_week.week_end` | Signup + 7 days |
| `d_member_first_week.board_state` | Joined a board within 7 days: reached / not |
| `d_member_first_week.connected_state` | Shared a board with another member within 7 days: reached / not (NULL if the previous step was not reached) |
| `d_member_first_week.post_state` | First post within 7 days, after connecting |
| `d_member_first_week.received_state` | After the first post, another member commented on or liked one of their posts written since then |
| `d_member_activity_week.life_week` | Week number since signup (from 0) |
| `d_member_activity_week.any_cnt` | Activities that week |
| `d_member_activity_week.post_cnt` | Posts that week |
| `d_calendar_week.week_start` | Week list made by the engine (Monday 00:00) |

raw.title: First-7-day activation funnel by signup week
raw.question: Where do new members drop off in their first 7 days?
raw.sql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT signup_week AS cohort, board_state, connected_state, post_state, received_state FROM d_member_first_week
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ALL', board_state, connected_state, post_state, received_state FROM d_member_first_week
)
SELECT cohort, 1 AS step_no, 'Signed up' AS step_name, count(*) AS reached, 0 AS unknown, count(*) AS eligible FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 2, 'Joined a board', sum(board_state = 'reached'), 0, count(*) FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 3, 'Connected with others', sum(connected_state = 'reached'), 0, sum(board_state = 'reached') FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 4, 'First post', sum(post_state = 'reached'), 0, sum(connected_state = 'reached') FROM f GROUP BY cohort
UNION ALL
SELECT cohort, 5, 'Got a reaction', sum(received_state = 'reached'), 0, sum(post_state = 'reached') FROM f GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY cohort, step_no
definition: Members at least 7 days past signup (signup week starts Monday)
Signed up → joined a board → shared a board with another member → first post → another member commented on or liked their post
Every step within 7 days of signup, after the previous step
Members who reached the previous step
caveats: Members who only read are not counted as active

raw.title: Weekly retention by first-week connection
raw.question: Do members who connect with others in their first 7 days stay longer than those who do not?
raw.sql:
WITH periods(period) AS (VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4), (5), (6), (7), (8)),
base AS (
  SELECT member_id, signup_week AS cohort, signup_at,
         CASE connected_state WHEN 'reached' THEN 'connected' ELSE 'unconnected' END AS series
  FROM d_member_first_week
  WHERE board_state = 'reached'
)
SELECT b.cohort, b.series, p.period,
       sum(w.member_id IS NOT NULL) AS numerator,
       count(*) AS denominator
FROM base b
JOIN periods p
  ON strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', b.signup_at, '+' || (7 * (p.period + 1)) || ' days') || substr(b.signup_at, 20) <= :as_of
LEFT JOIN d_member_activity_week w
  ON w.member_id = b.member_id AND w.life_week = p.period AND w.any_cnt > 0
GROUP BY b.cohort, b.series, p.period
ORDER BY b.cohort, b.series, p.period
definition: Members who joined a board within 7 days of signup
connected: shared a board with another member within 7 days / unconnected: did not
Wn = at least one post, comment or like in days [7n, 7n+7) after signup
Only members whose window has fully passed by the cutoff (observable)
caveats: Selection bias: members who are more active in their first week also connect more easily
Members who left are kept in the denominator and counted as inactive

raw.title: First post within 7 days, signups in the last 4 weeks
raw.question: What share of members who signed up in the last 4 weeks wrote a first post within 7 days?
raw.sql:
SELECT sum(post_state = 'reached') AS numerator,
       count(*) AS denominator,
       'Signups in the last 4 weeks' AS label
FROM d_member_first_week
WHERE signup_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', :as_of, '-35 days') || substr(:as_of, 20)
definition: Members who signed up within 35 days before the cutoff and are at least 7 days past signup (= last 4 weekly cohorts)
Members who wrote a first post within 7 days of signup, after connecting with another member

raw.title: 7-day board join rate by signup week (last 12 weeks)
raw.question: What is the 7-day board join rate for the last 12 complete signup weeks?
raw.sql:
SELECT signup_week AS x,
       sum(board_state = 'reached') AS numerator,
       count(*) AS denominator
FROM d_member_first_week
-- Signup week W is complete when W + 14 days ≤ cutoff: every signup in it has a full 7-day window
WHERE signup_week <= date(:as_of, '-14 days', 'weekday 0', '-6 days')
  AND signup_week >= date(:as_of, '-14 days', 'weekday 0', '-6 days', '-77 days')
GROUP BY signup_week
ORDER BY signup_week
definition: Members who signed up in the last 12 complete signup weeks (starting Monday), where every signup has had 7 days
Members who created or joined a board within 7 days of signup
